fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects potential DLL sideloading of "goopdate.dll", a DLL used by googleupdate.exe
fields.name: Potential Goopdate.DLL Sideloading
fields.query: event.type="Module Load" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (module.path contains "\\goopdate.dll" and (not (module.path contains "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\" or module.path contains "C:\\Program Files\\")) and (not (((src.process.image.path contains "\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\GUM" and src.process.image.path contains ".tmp\\Dropbox") and (module.path contains "\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\GUM" and module.path contains ".tmp\\goopdate.dll")) or ((src.process.image.path contains "\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\GUM" or src.process.image.path contains ":\\Windows\\SystemTemp\\GUM") and src.process.image.path contains ".tmp\\GoogleUpdate.exe" and (module.path contains "\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\GUM" or module.path contains ":\\Windows\\SystemTemp\\GUM"))))))
